newsitem.title: UK: National Power heads share in 2.6 mln profit-paper.
newsitem.headline: National Power heads share in 2.6 mln profit-paper.

text.p: National Power Plc executive directors shared in profits of more than 2.6 million stg over the last two years from exercising share options, the Daily Telegraph said on Thursday.

The paper said a report and accounts show that the pay package of chief executive Keith Henry rose 40 percent to more than 628,000 in the year ended March 31. The pay package was boosted by a special benefit payment of 119,800 that largely covered his cost of moving homes.
His basic salary was up 18 percent to 385,000, while a performance-linked bonus rose 12 percent to 123,000 stg.

John Baker, chairman, was the highest-paid executive last year with a package worth 674,000, up 250 percent on his 1995-96 remuneration package. His basic salary of 180,000 stg was raised by 262,000 profit from exercising options and 217,470 in shares from the first distribution of a three year share performance plan launched in 1993 and now worth two million stg, the paper said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
